title: Minä olen ...
description: Say who you are, where you are from and which languages you speak, in standard Finnish.

steps.title: The first question
steps.content_html: The YKI speaking test and every form start the same way: who are you? Today you say your name, your country and your languages.

steps.title: Your name
steps.content_html: <fi>Minun nimeni on Linh.</fi> My name is Linh. <fi>Minä olen Linh.</fi> I am Linh. In writing and in the test, use <fi>minä olen</fi>. Friends say <fi>mä oon</fi>; that comes later.
steps.tts_text: Minun nimeni on Linh. Minä olen Linh.

steps.title: Where you are from
steps.content_html: <fi>Mistä sinä olet kotoisin?</fi> Where are you from? <fi>Olen kotoisin Vietnamista.</fi> I am from Vietnam. The country gets <fi>-sta</fi>, or <fi>-stä</fi> when the word has ä, ö or y: <fi>Turkista, Ukrainasta, Egyptistä</fi>.
steps.tts_text: Mistä sinä olet kotoisin? Olen kotoisin Vietnamista.

steps.title: From which country?
steps.instruction: Match the country with 'from the country'.

steps.title: Your languages
steps.content_html: <fi>Minun äidinkieleni on turkki.</fi> My mother tongue is Turkish. <fi>Puhun turkkia ja vähän suomea.</fi> I speak Turkish and a little Finnish. After <fi>puhun</fi> the language gets -a or -ä: <fi>suomea, englantia, turkkia</fi>. Language names are written in small letters.
steps.tts_text: Minun äidinkieleni on turkki. Puhun turkkia ja vähän suomea.

steps.title: A little Finnish
steps.translation_hint: I speak English and a little Finnish.
steps.incorrect_feedback: After puhun the language ends in -a: suomea.

steps.title: Build it
steps.incorrect_feedback: Olen first, then kotoisin, then the country with -sta.

steps.title: The test begins
steps.scenario: The YKI speaking test asks the first questions on the computer.

persona.name: YKI-testi
persona.context: The recorded YKI speaking test: a voice on the computer asks each question once, clearly, then records the answer.

options.feedback: That says where you are from. The question is your name.
That is your language. The question is where you are from.

options.text: Puhun vietnamia, englantia ja vähän suomea.

options.feedback: The question is about languages: Puhun ...

steps.title: Your three sentences
steps.content_html: Minun nimeni on ... Olen kotoisin ...sta. Puhun ...a ja vähän suomea. Say them about yourself, out loud.
